messages:
Maria Chen: Hey @eng-security and @oncall-sre — I need a 30m just-in-time elevation to inspect/scrub LLM KV cache logs for a privacy QA. Found potential prompt leakage in model X rollout; want to validate and run a targeted redact pass. Logs are under s3://redwood-inference-prod/kvlogs/2026-03-18/sample-llm/*.gz. Will only read a small sample (<=100MB). :lock:

engsec-bot: Please include justification, exact scope, duration, and the commands you'll run. Also note who will approve.

Maria Chen: Justification: suspected user prompt leakage in recent canary. Scope: single pod `inference-rt-abc123` KV cache dump + the S3 sample path above, timeframe 15:00-15:30 UTC. Duration: 30 minutes. Commands I plan: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-inference-prod/kvlogs/2026-03-18/sample-llm/sample1.gz - | zcat | ./redact.py` and `kubectl exec -n prod-telemetry inference-rt-abc123 -- zcat /var/log/kvdump.gz | ./redact.py`. I will not copy raw files out of cluster; only sanitized snippets/screenshots.

Jamal Reyes: +1 on urgency. Confirming the pod lives in prod-telemetry namespace. Oncall FYI.

Cameron Patel: Approving conditionally — need EngSec checklist items satisfied (session recording + ephemeral role). Approver: Cameron Patel.

Elena (EngSec): Approved for 30m with conditions: 1) use ephemeral role `jit-elev-llm-scrub`, 2) record session via `session-recorder`, 3) no raw log export off-cluster, 4) paste regexes used for redaction here, 5) create a short ticket referencing this thread. Once you provide session ID I'll enable the role.

Maria Chen: Roger. Creating ticket now (incidents#12345). Will start session with: `session-recorder start --role=jit-elev-llm-scrub --note="kvlog scrub for model-X leak"` — I'll post session id here and won't copy raw artifacts out.

Sophie Li: Quick tip — use `aws s3 cp --only-show-errors --region=us-west-2` and `--max-keys`/`--range` to limit size; also `--request-payer` not needed for our bucket.

Maria Chen: session-id: sr_20260318_4532. @oncall-sre can you enable `jit-elev-llm-scrub` for 30m starting 15:00 UTC? I'll begin immediately once enabled.

oncall-sre: Enabled role for 30m starting at 1748800200 (15:00 UTC). Session recording is on. :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: Starting now. Will DM the sanitized snippet and paste a short redacted excerpt here once done. Thanks all.

Elena (EngSec): Noted. Please include the redaction regexes used and confirm no raw copies left on your workstation.

Maria Chen: Using redact.py with patterns: `(?i)email:\s*\S+`, `(?i)phone:\s*\S+`, `api_key=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`, and `USER_PROMPT:\s+\".*\"` — will paste sanitized sample only.

Jamal Reyes: :eyes:
